response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), station_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(*) AS n FROM joined GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandusagepct, SUM(n) AS telescope_count, CAST(SUM(n) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined) AS telescope_fraction FROM station_stats GROUP BY lunarstage;

assumptions.assumption: Each telescope's moon phase is the lunarstage of its matched observatory row, and NULL lunarstage values form one group. Station averages ignore NULL bandusagepct values, while telescopes with NULL bandusagepct still count toward telescope_count and the total.
